title: Product of geometrically irreducible schemes over a field is irreducible
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $U$ and $V$ be schemes over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] that are geometrically irreducible over $K$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then the fibre product $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].

source.place: Tag 038F (lemma-bijection-irreducible-components), the assertion that the product of geometrically irreducible schemes is irreducible

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-product-irreducible-components-bijection] with the geometrically irreducible scheme $U$ and the scheme $V$. The projection $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V\to V$ therefore induces a bijection between their sets of irreducible components.

Since $V$ is geometrically irreducible, its base change along the identity extension $K/K$ is irreducible, so $V$ has exactly one irreducible component. The bijection in Step 1 then shows that $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V$ has exactly one irreducible component $Z$. By [lem-sc-irreducible-components-cover] every point of $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V$ lies in some irreducible component, hence in $Z$; so $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V=Z$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].
